verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts for an online filing flow is a fair question for a state business-filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only lists filing types, services, and navigation links, with no mention of hours, daily caps, or session-timeout disclosures.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
